headline: Neither repository sealed, and for the first time the two share one newly identified cause. Both cleared BC-01 through BC-09 and both were rejected by BC-10 alone. Aspose.Cells for Java's blocking finding is CORRECT: the candidate really does carry a duplicated, orphaned lead-in sentence, and its cause is two section-scoped lookups in shared code (PROPOSALs AA and AB). proposal_AA.title: placements() computes a placed unit's overlap only against its DESTINATION section, so a preserved lead-in whose example the plan renders in another section is placed - orphaned from its own code block, which is renderer-owned.
proposal_AA.file: src/repository_presenter/components/readme/composition/placement.py, placements(): covered = planned_fact_ids(plan, destination) | renderer_fact_ids(destination, facts, plan)
proposal_AA.repository_and_finding: aspose-cells-foss/Aspose.Cells-FOSS-for-Java, F05 presentation/quick_start, the run's single blocking finding. The finding is right.

measured_zero_provider_calls.the_unit: inherited_unit:020.paragraph, value 'Load an existing workbook with options and inspect load diagnostics:', VERIFIED_PRESERVE -> additional_examples, citing example:002.
measured_zero_provider_calls.the_scoping: planned_fact_ids(plan,'additional_examples') = ['example:003']; planned_fact_ids(plan,'quick_start') = ['example:001','example:002']. example:002 is the plan's second_quick_start_example_id, so the overlap test against the destination alone returns [] and the outcome is 'placed'. Against the union over every included section the overlap is ['example:002'] and the outcome is 'overlap'.
measured_zero_provider_calls.the_orphaning: renders_verbatim('inherited_unit:020.paragraph', ...) is True but renders_verbatim('inherited_unit:021.code_block', ...) is False - the renderer owns java code blocks - so the companion code block is dropped as 'owned_elsewhere' while its lead-in is placed.
measured_zero_provider_calls.the_rendered_consequence: The sentence renders TWICE in the candidate: line 112, written by the authored unit quick_start/lead_in:2 with its code block, and line 190, at the tail of Additional Examples, followed immediately by a blank line and '## API Reference' - a colon-terminated sentence promising an example that is not there.
measured_zero_provider_calls.authoring_had_already_declined_it: content_units.json's omitted list names inherited_unit:020.paragraph and inherited_unit:021.code_block, both with reason 'belongs to a different section and is not cited by any slot in this objective'. Only the placement path resurrects the paragraph.
measured_zero_provider_calls.it_is_a_class_and_it_has_already_shipped: Replaying placements() over every sealed bundle on disk, exactly ONE placement changes under the union rule: aspose-cells-foss/Aspose.Cells-FOSS-for-.NET at 941814fd, inherited_unit:018.paragraph, 'Load a workbook with recovery diagnostics:' citing example:002. Its sealed README.md line 155 is that sentence, followed by a blank line and 'More runnable snippets adapted from the sample projects ... are collected below.' - the identical orphaned lead-in, in a second ecosystem, in a candidate that is already sealed and counted.
measured_zero_provider_calls.the_fix_is_close_to_byte_neutral: Across all ten sealed bundles (java, net, python, typescript, cpp, go, rust) the union rule changes exactly that one placement and no other; 9 of 10 bundles are untouched, and the tenth changes because it carries the defect.

proposal_AA.fix: Compute covered as the union of planned_fact_ids(plan, section) | renderer_fact_ids(section, facts, plan) over every INCLUDED section, not the destination alone: an example the document renders anywhere is rendered exactly once, so a preserved unit citing it duplicates it wherever the unit sits.
proposal_AA.alternative_rejected: Placing the companion code block too, so the lead-in is no longer orphaned. That re-introduces the duplication BC the renderer owns code blocks for (the same example would then be printed twice in full) and contradicts renders_verbatim's own contract.
proposal_AA.second_alternative_rejected: A renderer-side guard that drops a placed paragraph ending in ':' when no code block follows it. It hides the symptom and would silently delete a legitimately preserved sentence that happens to end in a colon.
proposal_AA.mutation_test: A VERIFIED_PRESERVE unit citing an example fact the plan renders in a different section must not be placed; a placed unit citing a fact no included section renders must still be placed (inherited_unit:045/047/048 of this run are the control - all three stay 'placed' under the union).

proposal_AB.title: The RC-04 misroute check reads the placed texts of the finding's OWN section_id, so a finding about a placed unit rendered in a different section than the reviewer labelled is routed to S6 and burns its one repair attempt.
proposal_AB.file: src/repository_presenter/components/readme/repair/targeted.py, review_defects(): placed_here = placed.get(section, []) then `if quote and any(quote in text for text in placed_here)`.

measured_zero_provider_calls.the_lookup: placed_texts() for this round is {'additional_examples': 1, 'development_testing': 3}. F05's quote is present in additional_examples' placed text and absent from quick_start's (which has none), so review_defects returns stage='S6', misrouted=False. Looking the quote up across every section's placed texts instead returns misrouted=True and stage='S4'.
measured_zero_provider_calls.the_control_in_the_same_run: aspose-slides-foss/Aspose.Slides-FOSS-for-Java's F06 quotes a placed text in its OWN section (development_testing), so it is already misrouted=True -> S4 today, and the union leaves it exactly as it is. The widening is additive.
measured_zero_provider_calls.what_the_misroute_cost: Routed to S6/quick_start, targeted_repair returned a change with path 'units', before = the finding's own text field verbatim and after = ''. That before string occurs nowhere in content_units.json and nowhere in README.md - it never was document text - yet the attempt was recorded outcome 'repaired', misrouted false. The finding re-raised, the run stopped at rounds 3 and BC-10 FAIL.

proposal_AB.fix: Scan every section's placed texts for the quote, not just the labelled section's. RC-04 already learned not to trust the reviewer's causal_stage; its section_id deserves the same treatment, because the property that matters - 'section_authoring never wrote this text and cannot revise it' - is a property of the text, not of the label.
proposal_AB.alternative_rejected: Trusting the reviewer to label the section the quoted text actually renders in. That is precisely the signal RC-04 was written because it cannot be trusted.
proposal_AB.secondary_observation: Independently of the routing, a repair change whose `before` occurs in no unit and in no rendered byte was recorded 'repaired'. A deterministic check could refuse it (the same shape as this lane's PROPOSAL N and Z: the round is spent, the document is unchanged, the finding re-raises). Recorded as an observation attached to this proposal rather than a third proposal.
proposal_AB.mutation_test: A finding whose quote is a placed text of a section other than its own section_id must be recorded misrouted and routed to S4; a finding whose quote is a placed text of its own section must keep today's answer.
